outline.use: 简化市域方位概览，非测绘底图或道路导航

townReference.use: 十家子区域方位参考，镇内图标为主题排布，非精确坐标

mapArtwork: 内置 image_gen 生成的无文字 AI 山水主题插画；网页叠加七条学习入口；非地理坐标或道路。

artwork.source: 内置 image_gen，参考用户提供的手绘导览画风进行生成编辑
artwork.changes: 删除所有标题、地名、图例、推荐线路说明和底图标签；右栏重绘为连续山水，当前底图只含图像。
artwork.rights: AI 主题插画，不宣称官方地图、实拍或当地建筑复原；原用户参考图仅归档。
artwork.prompt:
Mode: built-in image_gen; precise-object-edit; reference: github-pages/assets/atlas/fuxin-reference-map.png
Output: github-pages/assets/atlas/fuxin-landscape-clean.png
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: text-free painted landscape background for an interactive Fuxin agate cultural map. Input image 1 is the edit target and style reference. Remove EVERY text, Chinese character, letter, number, logo, map pin, label, signage, compass, scale bar, road shield, legend and information panel from this image. Remove the entire right-hand information column and replace it with continuous painted landscape. Also replace large calligraphy areas at upper left and bottom with natural terrain. Reconstruct a cohesive full-bleed horizontal hand-painted tourist landscape illustration, about 3:2 ratio. Preserve the fine watercolor / Chinese landscape painting aesthetic, warm ivory paper, verdant mountains, blue-green rivers, traditional courtyards, stone pagoda, lakes, market-town buildings and naturally banded red agate stones. Rich carefully painted natural detail, inviting daylight, green/gold/ochre palette. Use generous soft terrain spaces around features so seven separate HTML labels can be overlaid later. Composition: agate outcrop around 14% x 51%; banded agate and hills around 33% x 27%; courtyard around 52% x 45%; artisan workshop around 67% x 65%; small market buildings around 82% x 38%; river/lake around 85% x 82%; stone pagoda around 44% x 84%. Buildings are conceptual thematic illustrations, not a claim of exact geography. No embedded user interface or border. Critical: zero typography anywhere, no writing on buildings, no text-like markings, no colored route lines, no infographic panels. Entire final image is landscape artwork only.
